> [!CAUTION]
> **Please do NOT report security vulnerabilities via public issues.**
> Public reports expose all users to risk before a fix can be released.

## Responsible Disclosure

Please report security issues privately:
- **GitHub Security Advisories**: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/senurah/ansi-pixel/security/advisories/new)

## What to Include
- Detailed description of the vulnerability and attack vector
- Minimal steps or proof-of-concept to reproduce
- Affected versions, OS, and dependencies
